title: pilosella schultesii subsp. atra
intro: Pilosella schultesii subsp. atra, commonly known as Black Spleenwort, is a type of plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella schultesii subsp. atra include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
